entities.summary: Trunojoyo University (Unijoyo) is a public university in the Bangkalan Regency, in East Java province, Indonesia. Unijoyo was redesignated as a public university under the Presidential Decree dated July 5, 2001. The college was inaugurated on 23 July 2001 by President Abdurrahman Wahid.
